vsm2.21:84.1: “‘Emerges from the internal’ is said figuratively owing to the fact that in this case the insight leading to emergence has an internal state as its object. In the literal sense, however, the path emerges from both” (Vism-mhṭ 853).
vsm2.21:90.4: “Said in the Discourse on Purification (visuddhi-kathā)” (Vism-mhṭ 855). See XX.77.
